headline: SKF Prepares Automotive Unit Vertevo for Public Listing
summary: Swedish bearing manufacturer SKF is proceeding with the spin-off and IPO of its automotive arm SKF Vertevo under CEO Kerstin Enochsson.
why: SKF is one of the world's largest industrial bearing producers supplying global auto manufacturers.

impacts.name: SKF
impacts.why: SKF is proceeding with the standalone spin-off and listing of its automotive division.
